title: leucanthemopsis pallida subsp. alpina
intro: Leucanthemopsis pallida subsp. alpina, commonly known as White Alpine Daisy, is a flowering plant species native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Leucanthemopsis pallida subsp. alpina are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
